> Kind: STD | Scope: common | Capability: — | Loading: path-scoped (frontmatter paths)

# Dependency Standard (all ecosystems)

- Add a dependency only for a concrete current requirement; never install packages for hypothetical future use. An approved technology is not a reason to install it by default.

Related: every NuGet or npm addition, update, or removal runs `add-dependency`; approved and conditional technologies — decision register. Ecosystem-specific dependency standards load with backend and frontend files.
